nodes.label: Monorepo Architecture
nodes.rationale: Bun-powered monorepo with native Zig engine for maximum performance. Elysia backend with embedded SQLite via bun:sqlite. Frontend uses Vite + React + TanStack suite. Type safety bridged via Eden Treaty.

nodes.label: Technology Stack
nodes.rationale: Bun runtime + Elysia framework + Drizzle ORM + SQLite + React + TanStack suite + Shadcn UI on Base UI primitives. All chosen for performance and type safety.

nodes.label: Eden Treaty
nodes.rationale: End-to-end type-safe API client. All cross-boundary API queries must use edenTreaty<App> instantiated via @my-app/api-types workspace package. No manual fetch wrappers allowed.

nodes.label: API Types Bridge
nodes.rationale: packages/api-types workspace package exports types from apps/api/src/index.ts. Enables Eden Treaty to provide full type safety across frontend-backend boundary.

nodes.label: Drizzle ORM
nodes.rationale: ORM for SQLite schema management and migrations. Schema defined in apps/api/src/db/schema.ts only. Migrations generated via drizzle-kit generate.

nodes.label: Shadcn UI
nodes.rationale: UI component layer built on Base UI (@base-ui-components/react) primitives. Radix UI primitives are deprecated in favor of Base UI.

nodes.label: Tracking Fields Pattern
nodes.rationale: Each record should have created_by (foreignkey to users table), created_at, updated_by (foreignkey to users table), updated_at fields for audit trail.

nodes.label: Bun-Only Constraint
nodes.rationale: No npm, pnpm, or yarn allowed. No package-lock.json or pnpm-lock.yaml permitted. Always use bun for package operations. External SQLite drivers forbidden - use bun:sqlite.
